capabilities: Detect broken links to missing files, headings and blocks
List files with no incoming or outgoing vault connections
Flag isolated files that also contain broken links
Mark templates, archives and periodic notes as expected isolated
Filter results by file type and show in-note broken-link hints
extras: Never deletes files or rewrites links; the index is held in memory and rebuilt when needed, startup scanning is off by default, and external URLs are never requested.
problem: Broken links to missing files, headings or blocks, and files cut off from the rest of the vault, are hard to find by hand across Markdown, embeds, frontmatter, Canvas and Bases.
summary: Read-only sidebar scanner that lists broken internal links and files with no connections to other notes in the vault.
